# Merck Manuals

> Trusted medical reference providing evidence-based health information for healthcare professionals and consumers since 1899.

The Merck Manuals comprise two comprehensive editions: the Professional Edition for physicians and medical students, and the Consumer Version for general health education. Both leverage contributions from leading medical experts across major academic institutions and medical centers.

## Key Topics

- Merck Manual Professional Edition
- Merck Manual Consumer Version
- Medical reference
- Health conditions
- Disease overview
- Diagnostic procedures
- Symptom guide
- Health education
- Clinical content
- Physician credentials
- Medical experts
- Harvard Medical School
- Albert Einstein College of Medicine
- Northwestern University Feinberg School of Medicine

## Primary References

- [Merck Manual Professional Edition](https://www.merckmanuals.com/professional): Professional medical reference for doctors and students since 1899
- [Merck Manual Consumer Version](https://www.merckmanuals.com/home): Consumer home medical reference and health education resource
- [Global Medical Knowledge](https://www.merckmanuals.com/professional/resourcespages/global-medical-knowledge): Overview of Merck Manuals organization and global medical knowledge
